originalObject: A standard medium shipping delivery box.
tagline: Lightweight honeycomb display shelf for succulents and trinkets.
materialsNeeded: Woodgrain contact paper or matte paint
safetyNotes: Ensure hot glue guns rest on protective silicone mats.

steps.title: Cut 6 Equal Length Slats
steps.text: Cut six 12cm long by 8cm deep cardboard rectangles with 60-degree beveled ends.

steps.title: Double Layer for Strength
steps.text: Cut duplicate slats and glue face-to-face to create rigid 6mm composite struts.

steps.title: Form Hexagon Ring
steps.text: Join corners with wood glue, holding shape with painter tape until dry.

steps.title: Mounting Plate
steps.text: Add a small triangle card bracket at top corner for hanging on wall hook.

userNotes: Using this on my study desk.

tagline: Sub-irrigation planter that keeps moisture balanced for herbs.
materialsNeeded: Cotton wick or clean strip of old T-shirt (20cm)
safetyNotes: Smooth cut plastic edges with sandpaper or cover with paper tape to prevent sharp scrapes.
Always cut away from yourself on a stable cutting board.

steps.title: Clean & Delabel
steps.text: Wash bottle thoroughly with warm soapy water and peel off adhesive labels using warm water soak.

steps.title: Measure & Cut in Half
steps.text: Cut the bottle horizontally approximately 10cm from the top neck, creating an inverted funnel top and water reservoir base.

steps.title: Thread the Wick
steps.text: Drill or pierce a 5mm hole in the bottle cap. Thread the cotton strip halfway through so it wicks moisture upwards.

steps.title: Invert & Assemble
steps.text: Screw the cap back on and invert the funnel cone into the lower base reservoir.

steps.title: Plant & Hydrate
steps.text: Fill the top chamber with potting soil, plant your herb seedling, and fill bottom reservoir with fresh water.

userNotes: Placed on kitchen windowsill. Basil started sprouting new leaves after 4 days! No watering needed for a week.

tagline: Sturdy tiered compartment organizer with bespoke slots.
materialsNeeded: Non-toxic craft glue or hot glue
safetyNotes: Use a cutting mat to protect work surfaces.
Keep spare fingers well behind the metal ruler when scoring.

steps.title: Flatten & Disassemble
steps.text: Gently slice along taped seams to lay the cardboard box flat into workable panels.

steps.title: Measure Base & Outer Walls
steps.text: Mark a 24x16cm base plate and 8cm high outer perimeter walls.

steps.title: Score Dividers
steps.text: Cut 4 internal slot dividers with interlocking half-notches (comb joint style).

steps.title: Assemble Grid
steps.text: Interlock the internal grid pieces and affix them to the base plate using craft glue.

steps.title: Edge Finishing
steps.text: Cover exposed flute edges with kraft paper tape for a clean, furniture-grade finish.

userNotes: Finished the internal interlocking grid. Just need to glue the outer rim and tape the raw edges.
